name: quota-guard
description: Quota guard for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI): stops at a clean checkpoint before you hit your usage limit and resumes the chat by itself after the reset, with phone notifications (stopped, quota reset, working again, done).

session_soft.title: Soft threshold — 5-hour session (%)
session_soft.description: At this usage %, Claude finishes the current todo item, then stops cleanly (commits, writes progress notes).

session_hard.title: Hard threshold — 5-hour session (%)
session_hard.description: At this usage %, Claude can be stopped mid-item. With auto-revert off (default) this just forces a clean stop; with it on, the in-progress item is reverted with git stash.

weekly_soft.title: Soft threshold — weekly (%)
weekly_soft.description: At this usage %, Claude finishes the current todo item, then stops cleanly — same as the session soft threshold, but for the 7-day weekly quota.

weekly_hard.title: Hard threshold — weekly (%)
weekly_hard.description: Same as the session hard threshold, but for the 7-day weekly quota.

chat_auto_resume.title: Auto-resume chats after the quota resets
chat_auto_resume.description: On by default. When a threshold stops Claude in a normal chat, Claude schedules its own wake-up (Claude Code's CronCreate) for the reset time, and the chat continues by itself — no cc-run needed. The Claude Code window has to stay open until then. With notify_url set you get pings for: stopped, quota reset, working again, done. cc-run runs are unaffected.

hard_abort_enabled.title: Enable auto-revert (git stash) on the hard threshold
hard_abort_enabled.description: Off by default. When on, a hard threshold hit mid-item automatically reverts that item's changes with git stash and redoes it after the quota resets. Read the README's Safety section before enabling this.

language.title: Language / Dil
language.description: Language for the hook's user-facing status line (systemMessage) when a threshold stops Claude. Claude itself is always instructed in English regardless of this setting — this only affects what you, the human, see. Any code with a matching locales/<code>.json file works (currently: en, tr); an unrecognized code falls back to English.

notify_url.title: Notification webhook URL (optional)
notify_url.description: Sends a short status ping (threshold hit, resumed, done, gave up) to this URL via HTTP POST — tested against ntfy.sh (e.g. https://ntfy.sh/your-topic-name). Never task content or file names, only the same short status line already shown to you. Leave empty to disable. Deliberately never read from .cc-quota/config.json — only this screen or the CC_NOTIFY_URL env var can set it, since a cloned project's config.json setting this would otherwise be able to silently exfiltrate your session status to a URL you don't control.
